- `ArrayStoreException`: thrown if component types are incompatible or elements cannot be stored. Both `src` and `dest` are `long[]` (same primitive type), and all elements are `long`, so no type mismatch. This exception is avoided.
- `IndexOutOfBoundsException`: thrown if any index is negative or out-of-bounds. Here `srcPos=0`, `destPos=0`, `length=ret.length=copy.length` (non-negative). The bounds checks: `srcPos+length = copy.length <= src.length` and `destPos+length = copy.length <= dest.length`. So all indices are valid. This exception is avoided.

Since the code only reaches `arraycopy` when `copy` is non-null and all parameters are valid (matching lengths, non-negative indices, same primitive type), all three exceptions are avoided by the implicit validation from the preceding array creation and the semantics of the parameters.
